I build products that solve real problems in e-commerce—streamlining experiences, cutting through noise, and turning data into decisions. My mission? To make shopping smarter, faster, and more intuitive for millions.  

At EcomVista, I lead product strategy for high-growth platforms, bridging engineering, design, and business goals. I thrive in fast-paced environments where data-driven insights shape roadmaps and revenue outcomes. SQL analytics and customer feedback are my go-to tools for uncovering patterns that move the needle.  

In the past four years, I’ve driven a 15% uplift in conversion rates through iterative testing and user-centric design. I also reimagined our roadmap process, cutting time-to-market by 20% while aligning 10+ stakeholders. My focus is on ownership—owning outcomes, not just tasks.  

Looking ahead, I’m eager to collaborate on projects that blend innovation with measurable impact. Whether it’s scaling platforms or experimenting with new tech, I’m driven by solving complex problems and growing alongside teams that value agility and results. Let’s build something that matters.
